# dokku_global_logs (Resource)

Manages global Dokku log and Vector configuration (`dokku logs:set --global`, `logs:vector-start`, `logs:vector-stop`). Singleton resource with ID `global`.

## Requirements and lifecycle

1. Targets Dokku `v0.38.x` (uses `dokku logs:report --global --format json`, `vector-cron-sink`, and `vector-networks`).
2. `dokku_global_logs` is a singleton resource per Dokku host (`id = "global"`).
3. For sink DSNs containing API keys or tokens, prefer `vector_sink_wo` + `vector_sink_version` (and `vector_cron_sink_wo` + `vector_cron_sink_version`) with Terraform or OpenTofu `>= 1.11` so DSNs are not saved in plan files or Terraform state. Use `vector_sink` / `vector_cron_sink` for non-secret DSNs (e.g. `console://`) or older Terraform versions.
4. `vector_running` is `Optional` and `Computed`: omitting it leaves an externally managed Vector container untouched (including on `terraform destroy`). Setting `vector_running = true` or `false` manages `logs:vector-start` / `logs:vector-stop`, and changing `vector_image` or `vector_networks` while `vector_running` is `true` restarts Vector via `logs:vector-stop` followed by `logs:vector-start`.
5. Destroying this resource unsets all six global `logs:set --global` properties and stops Vector only if `vector_running` was managed as `true` by this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Requires Terraform/OpenTofu >= 1.11 for write-only sink DSNs (`*_wo`).
ephemeral "onepassword_item" "datadog_logs" {
  vault = var.onepassword_vault_id
  uuid  = var.datadog_item_id
}

resource "dokku_global_logs" "default" {
  max_size        = "50m"
  app_label_alias = "com.dokku.app-name"
  vector_image    = "timberio/vector:0.61.0-debian"
  vector_networks = ["observability"]
  vector_running  = true

  vector_sink_wo      = "datadog_logs://?api_key=${ephemeral.onepassword_item.datadog_logs.password}&site=datadoghq.com"
  vector_sink_version = 1
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `app_label_alias` (String) Global Vector label alias for the Dokku app name. Unset when omitted.
- `max_size` (String) Global container log max size (e.g. `10m`, `1g`, or `unlimited`). Unset when omitted.
- `vector_cron_sink` (String, Sensitive) Global Vector cron sink DSN (`SINK_TYPE://?SINK_OPTIONS`). Stored in Terraform state; prefer `vector_cron_sink_wo` for DSNs containing secrets.
- `vector_cron_sink_version` (Number) Increment to apply an updated `vector_cron_sink_wo` DSN.
- `vector_cron_sink_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only global Vector cron sink DSN (`SINK_TYPE://?SINK_OPTIONS`); not saved in Terraform state (requires Terraform/OpenTofu >= 1.11).
- `vector_image` (String) Docker image used for the global Dokku Vector container. Unset when omitted.
- `vector_networks` (Set of String) Docker networks attached to the global Vector container (`bridge` is disallowed). Unset when omitted.
- `vector_running` (Boolean) Whether the global Dokku Vector container should be running. Omit to leave an externally managed Vector container untouched.
- `vector_sink` (String, Sensitive) Global Vector sink DSN (`SINK_TYPE://?SINK_OPTIONS`). Stored in Terraform state; prefer `vector_sink_wo` for DSNs containing secrets.
- `vector_sink_version` (Number) Increment to apply an updated `vector_sink_wo` DSN.
- `vector_sink_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only global Vector sink DSN (`SINK_TYPE://?SINK_OPTIONS`); not saved in Terraform state (requires Terraform/OpenTofu >= 1.11).

### Read-Only

- `computed_app_label_alias` (String) Effective global app label alias reported by Dokku.
- `computed_max_size` (String) Effective global log max size reported by Dokku.
- `computed_vector_image` (String) Effective Vector Docker image reported by Dokku.
- `computed_vector_networks` (Set of String) Effective Vector Docker networks reported by Dokku.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `owned_vector_running` (Boolean) Internal marker tracking whether `vector_running` is explicitly managed by this resource.
- `vector_cron_sink_fingerprint` (String, Sensitive) SHA-256 hex digest of the remote global `vector-cron-sink` DSN, or empty when unset.
- `vector_sink_fingerprint` (String, Sensitive) SHA-256 hex digest of the remote global `vector-sink` DSN, or empty when unset.

## Import

Import the singleton global Dokku log configuration using ID `"global"`.

```shell
# Import the singleton global Dokku log configuration using ID "global".
terraform import dokku_global_logs.default global
```
